name: TOTP Recovery Codes
description: Displays a fresh recovery-code set issued after TOTP enrollment or recovery-code rotation so the user can save it before leaving the ceremony.

web.notes: Enrollment confirmation or maintenance rotation stores the returned recovery-code list only in ephemeral client flow state and navigates here for presentation.

mobile.notes: Mobile renders the recovery-code list returned by enrollment confirmation or maintenance rotation from ephemeral AuthFlowContext state and exposes the canonical Done action.

notes: Recovery codes are outputs of server operations and therefore belong on a destination view rather than as a mutated state of the submitting confirmation surface.
The same destination surface is intentionally reused by enrollment confirmation and recovery-code rotation.
